name: Amnesiac
ability: You do not know what your ability is. Each day, privately guess what it is: you learn how accurate you are.
designRole: Unknown Storyteller-specified ability with daily accuracy feedback; this app must not invent that ability.
explanation: Unknown Storyteller-specified ability with daily accuracy feedback; this app must not invent that ability.

nightInstructions.firstNight: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Amnesiac's ability.
nightInstructions.otherNights: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Amnesiac's ability.

storytellerNotes: The app does not create an Amnesiac ability. Import/retheme is supported; bespoke ability design stays with the Storyteller.

sources.title: The Pandemonium Institute: released character data

sources.description: Initial editable editorial annotations in data/design/botc-annotations.json. Numeric signals and synergy judgements are not official ratings.

generationRestriction: Reference and imported scripts supported. Automated generation excludes this role because it needs bespoke Storyteller adjudication or a nonstandard no-evil script.
